subject: 0.2: domain and range for nominal dscale

messages.author: 1161df5ae7a276da
messages.subject: 0.2: domain and range for nominal dscale
parts:
Hi all,

Setting a dscale seems to work differently in 0.2 from 0.1 - has the default for the sort option been changed? 

FWIW, help says default for sort is false.

Happy to file issue if needed.

Thanks,

Ian

types <- c("RED", "BLACK")

df <- data.frame(
  x = seq(1, 10),
  y = seq(1, 10),
  type = c(rep(types, each = 5))
)

# does not work how I expect (change from 0.1)
df %>%
  ggvis(x = ~x, y = ~y, fill = ~type) %>%
  layer_points() %>%
  set_dscale("fill", "nominal", domain = types, range = c("red", "black"))

# this does work how I expect
df %>%
  ggvis(x = ~x, y = ~y, fill = ~type) %>%
  layer_points() %>%
  set_dscale("fill", "nominal", sort = FALSE, domain = types, range = c("red", "black"))
